definitions.gloss: half-finished (drink); a drink one has started
definitions.explanation: A drink that someone has started and not finished: an opened bottle, a cup of coffee left on the desk. Used before a noun with の: {飲|の}みかけのお{茶|ちゃ}.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}みかけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧。
{飲|の}みかけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put the half-finished juice in the fridge.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}みかけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペットボトル→ペットボトル：05605_pettobotoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧まま⟦{出|で}かけて→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I went out and left a half-empty plastic bottle on the desk.

notes:
Formed from the stem of ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ and かけ, which marks an action begun and not finished. An opened bottle of wine or sake is also {飲|の}みかけ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}みかけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: left half-drunk
- {飲|の}みかけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧: an opened bottle of wine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べかけ→食べかけ：33954_tabekake⟧: half-eaten — the same pattern with food
- {飲|の}み{残|のこ}し: the part of a drink left undrunk
